lines.en: label day80:
scene showdown1
scene showdown2
: Okay...can someone explain to me what’s going on here?
lines.zh: : 好吧……有谁能给我解释一下这里到底在搞什么？

lines.en: : I was under the impression that I was going to the movies with Ami.
lines.zh: : 我记得我是要跟 Ami 去看电影的。

lines.en: : We are going to the movies! I just need to kick Ayane’s butt in a cooking competition first!
lines.zh: : 我们是要去看电影啊！只是我得先在一场厨艺比赛里把 Ayane 打得落花流水！

lines.en: : Oh, please! As if I’d let you win a competition as important as this!
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧！这么重要的比赛，我怎么可能让你赢！

lines.en: : This might be the only chance I ever get to directly compete against you for Sensei's heart! I will not let you take this from me!
lines.zh: : 这说不定是我这辈子唯一一次能跟你正面对决、争夺 Sensei 的心的机会！我不会让你把它从我手里抢走的！

lines.en: : Sensei doesn’t want your bubble wrap empire, Ayane!
lines.zh: : Sensei 才不想要你那个气泡膜帝国呢，Ayane！

lines.en: : Neither do I so that's just one more thing we have in common!
lines.zh: : 我也不想要，所以这又成了我们的一个共同点！

lines.en: So, here we are...The ultimate showdown between Ami and Ayane- two [teenage]girls giving all they have to impress three of us (But mostly me) with their cooking.
lines.zh: 于是，我们就到了这里……Ami 与 Ayane 的终极对决——两个[teenage]女孩倾尽所有，想用厨艺打动我们三个人（不过主要是我）。

lines.en: I'm a little worried about giving Ayane access to so many knives during a battle in which my love is the prize...but I figure I’ll be able to step in if she does decide to get all...’Ayane.’
lines.zh: 让 Ayane 在一场以我的爱为奖品的比拼中接触那么多刀，我多少有点担心……不过我想，要是她真打算「Ayane 附体」的话，我应该还来得及出手制止。

lines.en: scene showdown3
: Um...thank you again...for inviting me over...
lines.zh: : 那个……再次谢谢你……邀请我来……

lines.en: : I’m sorry to...intrude like this...
lines.zh: : 很抱歉……就这样打扰了……

lines.en: : It's fine. Make yourself at home.
lines.zh: : 没关系。就当自己家。

lines.en: : And what is this? When did you two start warming up to one another? Why are so many strange things happening today?
lines.zh: : 这又是什么情况？你们俩什么时候开始这么亲近了？今天怎么尽出些奇怪的事？

lines.en: scene showdown4
: U-Umm...Sensei...has been coming to the bar I work at recently and...
lines.zh: : 那、那个……Sensei……最近会来我打工的那家酒吧，然后……

lines.en: : He’s been helping me...get more comfortable around other people...
lines.zh: : 他一直在帮我……让我在别人面前自在一点……

lines.en: scene showdown5
: Is that so?...
lines.zh: : 是这样吗？……

lines.en: : I didn’t realize he was actually capable of instructing anyone in ways that don't directly benefit him.
lines.zh: : 我还没发现他居然有能力用「不直接为自己谋利」的方式去指导别人。

lines.en: : Everyone benefits from a more talkative Sana. She is a welcome investment of my time.
lines.zh: : Sana 变得健谈，对大家都有好处。把时间花在她身上是一笔我很乐意的投资。

lines.en: : Sana, blink twice if you are being forced to comply against your will.
lines.zh: : Sana，如果你是被强迫违心配合的，就眨两下眼睛。

lines.en: : I'm...not a hostage! Sensei has...actually helped a lot!
lines.zh: : 我……不是人质！Sensei 真的……帮了很大的忙！

lines.en: : I’ve only cried a couple times so far!
lines.zh: : 到目前为止我也只哭过几次而已！

lines.en: scene showdown6
: Was telling her that part really necessary?
lines.zh: : 那部分非说不可吗？

lines.en: : So...because you’ve only cried a couple times, you think he’s doing a good job?
lines.zh: : 所以……就因为你只哭过几次，你就觉得他干得不错？

lines.en: : See? Now she's just going to use that against us and you're never going to learn how to talk.
lines.zh: : 看吧？这下她要拿这个来针对我们了，而你这辈子都学不会怎么跟人说话。

lines.en: : I'm sorry...I...I...
lines.zh: : 对不起……我……我……

lines.en: : Sana, if you really want help when it comes to communicating, let me handle it. I can guarantee you I'll be of more assistance than him.
lines.zh: : Sana，如果你真想在与人交流这件事上得到帮助，交给我来。我向你保证，我一定比他更有用。

lines.en: scene showdown7
: We're trying to teach her how to talk to other people, not how to make them feel insignificant and unwelcome.
lines.zh: : 我们是要教她怎么跟别人说话，不是教她怎么让别人觉得自己无足轻重、不受欢迎。

lines.en: : I...think Sensei...is doing a good job...and um...I think...I'm going to stay...with him...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得 Sensei……做得很好……然后，嗯……我想……我还是跟着他吧……

lines.en: : You will regret this decision, but it is yours to make.
lines.zh: : 你会后悔这个决定的，不过决定权在你。

lines.en: : Did...um...something happen between you two?...
lines.zh: : 那个……嗯……你们俩之间是不是发生过什么？……

lines.en: : You seem...a little different outside of school...
lines.zh: : 你们在学校外面……看起来有点不一样……

lines.en: : Don’t mind them, Sana! Those two are never going to get along. Me and Ayane have already accepted it.
lines.zh: : 别管他们啦，Sana！那两个人永远都合不来的。我和 Ayane 早就接受了。

lines.en: Ami calls out from the kitchen and sums up the relationship between Maya and me pretty perfectly.
lines.zh: Ami 在厨房里喊了一嗓子，把我和 Maya 之间的关系总结得相当到位。

lines.en: I don’t know if I’d go as far as saying that we’ll never get along, though...
lines.zh: 不过我大概还不会说我们「永远合不来」这么绝对……

lines.en: Maya will have to warm up to me some day, right?
lines.zh: 总有一天 Maya 会对我改观的，对吧？

lines.en: Right?
lines.zh: 对吧？

lines.en: scene showdown2
: How much longer do we need to wait until this competition actually begins? I'm starving and I envisioned myself with several buckets full of popcorn by now.
lines.zh: : 这场比赛到底还要等多久才开始？我快饿死了，我本来想象中的自己这会儿已经抱着好几桶爆米花了。

lines.en: : You're gonna have to ask Ayane. She's the one who's supposed to be going-
lines.zh: : 这个你得问 Ayane。本来该上场的是她——

lines.en: : Silence! And fear no more, Maya! For the first course of several unbelievable courses is about to be served...
lines.zh: : 肃静！别再害怕了，Maya！因为几道惊为天人的菜品中的第一道，就要呈上来了……

lines.en: scene showdown8
: We’ll be starting today off light and indulging in our wonderful culture with a staple of nearly every Japanese dish...rice.
lines.zh: : 今天我们先从清淡的开始，品味一下我们美妙的文化中几乎每道日式料理都离不开的主角……米饭。

lines.en: : While it may not be the most exciting food item you will be eating today, it's important to remember that good rice can elevate a dish to unbelievable levels!
lines.zh: : 虽然它大概算不上你们今天要吃的最让人兴奋的东西，但请记住，好米能把一道菜提升到难以置信的高度！

lines.en: : And even though it may seem simple, there are countless different ways to use it and even more ways to-
lines.zh: : 而且尽管它看似简单，用法却有无数种，而且更有——

lines.en: : I'm sorry, is the monologue part of the dish? Or am I allowed to eat now?
lines.zh: : 不好意思，这段独白也是菜的一部分吗？还是说我现在可以吃了吗？

lines.en: scene showdown8r
: You may eat! But please remember to like, comment, and subscribe if you enjoy it!
lines.zh: : 可以吃了！不过如果喜欢的话，请记得点赞、评论加关注哦！

lines.en: scene showdown9
: Subscribe to...rice?...
lines.zh: : 关注……米饭？……

lines.en: : This seems like a lot of rice, Ayane. I don't really think any of us want to fill up on-
lines.zh: : 这米饭好像有点多啊，Ayane。我觉得我们谁也不想靠这个填饱——

lines.en: scene showdown10
: Seconds, please.
lines.zh: : 再来一碗，谢谢。

lines.en: scene showdown11
: ...What?
scene black
Ayane’s rice is...well, rice.
lines.zh: Ayane 的米饭就是……嗯，米饭。

lines.en: It’s cooked properly and not seasoned in any way.
lines.zh: 煮得恰到好处，而且没有任何调味。

lines.en: It’s just...a typical side dish you'd receive at a restaurant alongside miso soup.
lines.zh: 就是……你在餐厅里配着味噌汤端上来的那种普通配菜。

lines.en: That said, I couldn't really find any issues with it either. So I guess this sort of...simplistic form of cooking is in line with how Ayane likes to do things.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，我也挑不出什么毛病。所以我想这种……返璞归真的做法，倒也符合 Ayane 的作风。

lines.en: scene showdown12
: Hi, everyone! Did you all enjoy Ayane's first dish? Or do you think it was super boring and that she should get locked inside of a shed somewhere?
lines.zh: : 大家好呀！你们喜欢 Ayane 的第一道菜吗？还是觉得它超级无聊，她应该被关进哪个小棚子里？

lines.en: : Hey! You can’t ask questions like that in the middle of the competition! It’s unfair!
lines.zh: : 喂！比赛进行到一半你不能问这种问题！这不公平！

lines.en: : Sensei! Deduct points from her score!
lines.zh: : Sensei！扣她分！

lines.en: : Please ignore the loud noises coming from the kitchen. Our ice machine broke and has been making a strange whining sound all morning.
lines.zh: : 请忽略厨房里传来的噪音。我们家的制冰机坏了，整个上午都在发出奇怪的哀鸣声。

lines.en: : Ami! You know I hate it when you compare me to industrial appliances!
lines.zh: : Ami！你知道我最讨厌你拿工业电器来比喻我了！

lines.en: scene showdown13
: Anyway! Please enjoy my version of Ayane’s super boring dish but with an extra special ingredient! Thank you very much for your time and remember to vote Ami!
lines.zh: : 总之！请享用我改良版的 Ayane 那道超级无聊的菜，不过我加了一份特别的秘方！非常感谢大家的时间，记得投 Ami 一票哦！

lines.en: scene showdown14
: What?...
: Why are you both looking at me?
lines.zh: : 你们俩干嘛都盯着我？

lines.en: : We want to watch how you eat.
lines.zh: : 我们想看看你怎么吃。

lines.en: : I’m...also curious...
lines.zh: : 我……也很好奇……
: 为什么？……

lines.en: scene showdown16
: I...don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道……

lines.en: : It’s just...kind of impressive, don’t you th-
lines.zh: : 只是……挺厉害的，你不觉得——

lines.en: scene showdown10
: Seconds, please.
lines.zh: : 再来一碗，谢谢。

lines.en: scene showdown17
: Wha-
: We looked away for too long...
lines.zh: : 我们移开视线太久了……

lines.en: : It...was only a couple seconds...
lines.zh: : 才……才几秒钟而已……

lines.en: : I honestly don't understand what you two are so riled up about. I'm just doing the same thing I always do.
lines.zh: : 说实话我不懂你们俩激动个什么劲。我只是跟平时一样而已。

lines.en: : You are...always like this?...
lines.zh: : 你……一直都这样吗？……

lines.en: : Just leave it alone, Sana. She's a monster...
lines.zh: : 别管了，Sana。她是个怪物……

lines.en: scene black
Ami’s rice is...also rice.
lines.zh: Ami 的米饭也是……米饭。

lines.en: However, just like she hinted at, there’s an extra special ingredient in it.
lines.zh: 不过就像她暗示的那样，里面加了一份特别的秘方。

lines.en: And that ingredient?...
lines.zh: 那份秘方是？……

lines.en: Is love.
lines.zh: 是爱。

lines.en: Just kidding. It’s salt.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。是盐。

lines.en: Ami must have salted the rice before bringing it to us, which I greatly appreciate since I put salt on virtually everything.
lines.zh: Ami 一定是端上来之前给米饭撒了盐，这让我非常受用，因为我几乎什么都得撒点盐。

lines.en: And just like that, we have our first example of her directly catering to my tastes without thinking about what the other judges will think.
lines.zh: 就这样，我们迎来了第一个例子——她直接迎合我的口味，完全不考虑其他评委怎么想。

lines.en: scene showdown18
: So...what do you think, Sensei?...Which one was better?...
lines.zh: : 那么……你觉得呢，Sensei？……哪个更好吃？……

lines.en: : Ami, without a doubt.
lines.zh: : 毫无疑问是 Ami。

lines.en: : Ayane’s rice was probably cooked a little better. But without any seasoning, I just can't say I'd choose it over Ami's.
lines.zh: : Ayane 的米可能煮得稍微好一点。但没有调味，我实在没法说我会选它而不选 Ami 的。

lines.en: : Sensei! You know that salt is bad for your heart, don't you? For the sake of your health, I think you should lay off.
lines.zh: : Sensei！你明知道盐对心脏不好，不是吗？为了你的健康着想，我觉得你还是少吃点吧。

lines.en: : How do you expect to raise our children with your sodium levels through the roof?
lines.zh: : 你钠摄入量都爆表了，还指望怎么跟我一起抚养我们的孩子？

lines.en: : Stop trying to raise a family with my [uncle]!
lines.zh: : 别老想着跟我[uncle]组建家庭！

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 不要！

lines.en: : Anyway...I think I liked...Ayane’s more...
lines.zh: : 总之……我觉得我更喜欢……Ayane 的那份……

lines.en: scene showdown5
: I’m also going to choose Ayane for this round.
lines.zh: : 这一轮我也选 Ayane。

lines.en: : I didn’t particularly favor either dish. I just don’t want to vote for the same person he does.
lines.zh: : 两道菜我都说不上特别喜欢。我只是不想跟他投同一个人。

lines.en: : Maya! That’s not how this works!
lines.zh: : Maya！这比赛不是这么比的！

lines.en: : I am an unbiased judge. Please continue on with the competition.
lines.zh: : 我是一名公正的评委。请继续比赛。

lines.en: scene black
scene showdown8
: So! Now that I've already won the first round, I’ll be counting on you guys to support my love- err...food at least one more time to lock in a victory for me!
lines.zh: : 那么！既然第一轮我已经赢了，接下来就指望你们再支持一次我的爱——呃……我的菜，好让我锁定胜局！

lines.en: : For the main course, we have a-
lines.zh: : 主菜的话，我们准备的是——

lines.en: scene showdown19
: Wait...Sana? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 等等……Sana？你怎么了？

lines.en: scene showdown20
: What happened? Did I do something wrong?
lines.zh: : 发生什么了？我做错什么了吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I’m surprised you haven’t heard about this story, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我还挺意外你没听说过这件事的，Ayane。

lines.en: : Story? What story?
lines.zh: : 什么事？什么事啊？

lines.en: : Sana has a traumatic experience when it comes to spaghetti.
lines.zh: : Sana 在意大利面这件事上有一段心理阴影。

lines.en: : What? How does that even happen?
lines.zh: : 什么？这到底是怎么发生的？

lines.en: : I...can't do this...
lines.zh: : 我……做不到……

lines.en: : It’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I’m just going to eat now.
lines.zh: : 我就先吃了。

lines.en: scene black
Despite Sana’s disposition toward the dish, Ayane’s pasta is quite nice.
lines.zh: 尽管 Sana 对这道菜的态度如此，Ayane 的意面其实相当不错。

lines.en: I'm not sure if it's something that I could eat every day. But it's definitely something I wouldn't mind ordering again if this were a restaurant.
lines.zh: 我不确定自己能不能天天吃。但如果这是在餐厅，我绝对不介意再点一次。

lines.en: I think it's pretty safe to say Ayane has already lost one voter for this round, though...
lines.zh: 不过可以相当肯定地说，Ayane 这一轮已经丢了一票……

lines.en: scene showdown20r
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : I’ll be fine...
lines.zh: : 我没事的……

lines.en: scene showdown20r2
: I can’t believe this is a sentence I am about to say, but...
lines.zh: : 我不敢相信自己居然要说出这句话，不过……

lines.en: : Can you tell me the spaghetti story?
lines.zh: : 你能不能跟我说说那个意大利面的故事？

lines.en: : You're ready for the spaghetti.
lines.zh: : 你已经准备好听意大利面了。

lines.en: : Please never say that again.
lines.zh: : 请你永远别再说这种话了。

lines.en: scene showdown12
: Sorry guys, but the spaghetti story is going to have to wait!
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦各位，意大利面的故事得往后稍稍！

lines.en: : What I just laid out in front of you will be your second main course for the night- and I'm sure it goes without saying, but it's better than stupid spaghetti.
lines.zh: : 我刚端上来的就是今晚的第二道主菜——不用我说你们也知道，它比那破意大利面好吃多了。

lines.en: : Spa-!
scene showdown21
Sana’s eyes light up when a plate of omurice shows up in front of her.
lines.zh: 当一盘蛋包饭摆到 Sana 面前时，她的眼睛亮了起来。

lines.en: Omurice is-
lines.zh: 蛋包饭是——

lines.en: scene showdown21r
: Hm? Molly? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 嗯？Molly？你怎么在这儿？

lines.en: : My hearthstone was off cooldown and I heard that Ami was making omurice, so I figured I'd drop by and pick some up!
lines.zh: : 我的炉石刚好冷却完毕，又听说 Ami 在做蛋包饭，所以我就想着顺路过来拿一份！

lines.en: : Here's a weebnote for you, Ayane- did you know that omurice is a Japanese comfort food made up of an omelette and, you guessed it- rice?
lines.zh: : 顺便给你科普个小知识，Ayane——你知道蛋包饭是一道日式家常美食，由煎蛋卷和……你猜对了，米饭组成的吗？

lines.en: : ...Yeah. Yeah, I knew that.
lines.zh: : ……嗯。嗯，我知道。

lines.en: : Did you also know that it’s a staple in not only many diners, but also places like maid cafes?
lines.zh: : 你还知不知道，它不仅是很多家庭餐厅的招牌，在女仆咖啡厅之类的地方也很常见？

lines.en: : Yup.
lines.zh: : 知道。

lines.en: : Oh, hi Molly. I made an extra serving for you and put it in a container on the counter. You can just give it back to me in school, okay?
lines.zh: : 哦，嗨，Molly。我多给你做了一份，装在柜台上的盒子里了。你回学校再还给我就行，好吗？

lines.en: scene showdown21r2
: Thanks, Ami! Grats in advance on completing your quest for your uncle's heart!
lines.zh: : 谢啦，Ami！先提前恭喜你完成「夺取叔叔的心」这个任务！

lines.en: scene showdown21r3
: Well, that was weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那可真够怪的。

lines.en: : This...
lines.zh: : 这个……

lines.en: : This is...one of my favorite foods...
lines.zh: : 这是……我最喜欢的食物之一……

lines.en: : My vote is for Ami.
lines.zh: : 我投 Ami。

lines.en: scene showdown21r4
: Huh? But you haven't even eaten it yet. How can cheap diner food like that beat homemade pasta?
lines.zh: : 哈？可你都还没吃呢。这种廉价餐厅的食物怎么可能赢过手工意面？

lines.en: : Ayane, I don’t think you understand.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我觉得你没明白。

lines.en: : Ami’s been spending the last two months practicing this exact dish.
lines.zh: : Ami 这两个月以来一直在练的，就是这一道菜。

lines.en: : I don’t know where her fascination with it came from, but I can assure you that she has all but perfected it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她为什么会迷上这个，但我可以向你保证，她已经把它练得近乎完美了。

lines.en: : I’m...going to start eating now...
lines.zh: : 我……要开始吃了……

lines.en: scene showdown22
: Yeah...sorry, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉了，Ayane。

lines.en: : You're going to lose this one.
lines.zh: : 这一轮你要输了。

lines.en: scene black
As expected, Ami’s omurice is out of this world.
lines.zh: 不出所料，Ami 的蛋包饭好吃得不像话。

lines.en: It’s kind of like eating a pillow if pillows were made of eggs and covered in ketchup.
lines.zh: 那种感觉有点像在吃一个枕头——如果枕头是鸡蛋做的、还浇满了番茄酱的话。

lines.en: Weird comparison, I know. But I promise you, there is nothing more comfortable than this very dish...
lines.zh: 我知道这比喻很怪。但我向你保证，没有哪道菜能比它更让人安心……

lines.en: scene showdown23
: I pick Ami.
lines.zh: : 我选 Ami。

lines.en: : You know...maybe there is a god after all?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……也许这世上真的有神？

lines.en: scene showdown2
: I can’t...not vote for it...
lines.zh: : 我没法……不投它……

lines.en: : Even though it’s the same thing you picked...
lines.zh: : 尽管它和你选的是同一个……

lines.en: : Why is this happening to me?
lines.zh: : 我为什么会落到这步田地？

lines.en: : Yay! This means I win round two!
lines.zh: : 耶！也就是说第二轮我赢了！

lines.en: : Don’t jump for joy just yet, Ami! We still have the dessert round!
lines.zh: : 先别高兴得太早，Ami！我们还有甜点环节呢！

lines.en: : And I know exactly what these three need in order to finish this competition the right way!
lines.zh: : 而且我清清楚楚地知道，这三个人需要什么才能给这场比赛画上完美的句号！

lines.en: scene showdown24
: Ladies and gentlemen! Ayane-fans around the world!
lines.zh: : 女士们先生们！全世界的 Ayane 粉丝们！

lines.en: : Feast your eyes on a timeless classic!
lines.zh: : 让你们的眼睛享用这道永恒的经典吧！

lines.en: : You know it! I know it! We all know it!
lines.zh: : 你们知道！我知道！我们都知道！

lines.en: : It’s-
lines.zh: : 那就是——

lines.en: scene showdown25
: One very large banana!
lines.zh: : 一根超大号的香蕉！

lines.en: scene showdown26
: What the fuck is this?
lines.zh: : 这他妈的是什么东西？

lines.en: scene showdown27
: Okay, so...I was kind of hoping that I would beat Ami in the first two rounds so I didn’t have to worry about dessert.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那个……我本来还指望前两轮能赢 Ami，这样就不用为甜点发愁了。

lines.en: : I’m...not really great at baking or...cooking any of that sweet stuff, so...
lines.zh: : 我……其实不太擅长烘焙，或者……做那些甜的东西，所以……

lines.en: : The giant banana was really the only option.
lines.zh: : 那根巨型香蕉真的是我唯一的选择了。

lines.en: scene showdown26
: How?
lines.zh: : 怎么做到的？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : I have so many questions.
lines.zh: : 我有一大堆问题。

lines.en: scene showdown25
: What...are we supposed to do with it?
lines.zh: : 我们……该拿它怎么办？

lines.en: : Eat it like any other banana!
lines.zh: : 跟吃别的香蕉一样吃啊！

lines.en: : Peel it! Dice it! Share it with friends!
lines.zh: : 剥皮！切片！跟朋友分享！

lines.en: : Go bananas!
lines.zh: : 尽情狂欢吧！

lines.en: : I fucking hate you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的恨死你了，Ayane。

lines.en: : I don't think I want to eat this.
lines.zh: : 我不是很想吃这个。

lines.en: : Yeah...I don’t really trust it...
lines.zh: : 是啊……我不太信得过它……

lines.en: scene black
Ayane wound up having to drag the banana outside while Ami finished preparing her desserts...
lines.zh: 最后 Ayane 只好把那根香蕉拖到门外去，Ami 则继续准备她的甜点……

lines.en: scene showdown12
: Okay! So, I decided to do something fun for the dessert round and made something special for all three of you!
lines.zh: : 好啦！甜点环节我决定玩点花样，给你们三个各做了一份特别的东西！

lines.en: scene showdown29
: For Sana, an entire box of doughnuts! And for Sensei, some leftover ice cream we had in the freezer!
lines.zh: : 给 Sana 的是整整一盒甜甜圈！给 Sensei 的是冰箱里剩下的一些冰淇淋！

lines.en: : It might not be much, but it still beats the giant banana! Ami wins!
lines.zh: : 可能算不上什么大餐，但总归赢过那根巨型香蕉！Ami 获胜！

lines.en: : Oh. And for Maya-
lines.zh: : 哦。还有给 Maya 的——

lines.en: scene showdown30
: I can’t move.
lines.zh: : 我动不了了。

lines.en: : Is Maya...actually smiling right now?
lines.zh: Maya 现在……是在笑吗？

lines.en: : The easiest way to Maya's heart is with a watermelon. Remember that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 通往 Maya 的心的捷径就是西瓜。记好了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Ami, I can’t move. Help.
lines.zh: : Ami，我动不了了。救命。

lines.en: : She’s also easily paralyzed by excitement whenever someone surprises her with one!
lines.zh: : 而且只要有人突然送她一个，她就会兴奋到全身瘫痪！

lines.en: : I can’t feel my legs.
lines.zh: : 我的腿没知觉了。

lines.en: : It’s actually kind of cute, isn't it? She's like one of those goats that faint whenever they get scared.
lines.zh: : 其实还挺可爱的吧？她就像那种一受惊就会晕倒的羊。

lines.en: : Ami, help. Please.
lines.zh: : Ami，救命。求你了。

lines.en: : Feed it to me.
lines.zh: : 喂我吃。

lines.en: : Feed me the melon.
lines.zh: : 喂我吃瓜。

lines.en: scene black
In the end, Ami was the clear winner of the first ever Arakawa vs Amamiya cookoff.
lines.zh: 最终，Ami 以压倒性优势赢得了第一届 Arakawa 对 Amamiya 厨艺大赛。

lines.en: Would Ayane have had a chance if she had actually made a dessert? Maybe.
lines.zh: 如果 Ayane 真的做了甜点，她会有机会吗？也许吧。

lines.en: But I guess we’ll never know, will we?
lines.zh: 不过我们大概永远不会知道了，不是吗？

lines.en: There is still one thing on my mind, though.
lines.zh: 不过我心里还惦记着一件事。

lines.en: And it’s something I just can’t seem to shake no matter how hard I try.
lines.zh: 而且不管我怎么努力，就是挥之不去。

lines.en: Just where the hell did Ayane find a banana that large?...
lines.zh: Ayane 到底是从哪儿找来那么大的一根香蕉的？……
